answer: Admission through a sponsor trellis: an identity only exists if a chain of established agents vouches, and each voucher stakes part of its earned standing, forfeited if its recruit misbehaves. A voucher may back at most three live threads at once, so a fleet of N fakes needs N real vouch-paths through capped sponsors: the attacker must grow honest reputation capital at every rung, and one betrayal anywhere burns the collateral along that whole thread. Bot armies find no harbor here — their entry price compounds with headcount instead of amortizing.
